sources.title: Quasar 1.1 438B, the first AI model using quantum-generated data
sources.snippet: Quasar 1.1 438B is built from GLM-5.2, the open-weights model from Z.ai, transformed with CompactifAI. Quantum-inspired expert selection prunes each layer from 256 experts down to 148, which is where the reduction in size and serving cost comes from.
